sloka: ततो द्यां पृथिवीं चैव वीक्षमाणा वनौकसः ।ददृशुः सन्ततौ बाणैर्भ्रातरौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४६.१ ।।।।
transliteration: tato dyāṁ pṛthivīṁ caiva vīkṣamāṇā vanaukasaḥ ।dadṛśuḥ santatau bāṇairbhrātarau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.46.1 ।।।।

translations.english: Thereafter looking at the sky and the ground for Rama and Lakshmana, the Vanara leaders saw the two brothers, lying on the ground hurt by arrows.
